name: csi-etabs
description: Lets Claude drive ETABS through the CSI API: build and edit models, run analyses and design, read database tables and results. Unofficial, not affiliated with Computers and Structures, Inc.
long_description: Connects Claude to a local ETABS installation through its COM API. Claude can attach to the running ETABS window or start a new instance, build or edit the model, run the analysis and design, and read any database table or Results function. Adds story data, story drifts and pier/spandrel forces, and concrete, steel, composite, slab and shell design runs. A generic call_api tool reaches every function of the API, and search_api/api_doc read the API help file of your own installation. Requires Windows and a licensed ETABS. Unofficial tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Computers and Structures, Inc.
